sys.path.append('/path/to/tools')
from tools import search_hotels, filter_hotels, search_attractions, filter_attractions, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache, sort_results

attractions_cache_key = "attractions_las_vegas"
attractions_results = get_results_from_cache(key=attractions_cache_key)

# Search for hotels in Las Vegas with specified criteria
hotel_cache_key = "hotels_las_vegas_3_star_80_per_night"
hotel_results = get_results_from_cache(key=hotel_cache_key)

if hotel_results is None:
    hotel_results = search_hotels(
        city="Las Vegas",
        checkin_date=["2025-08-03", "2025-08-04", "2025-08-05", "2025-08-06", "2025-08-07"],
        checkout_date=["2025-08-11"],
        num_people=5,
        stars=[3],
        budget=80
    )
    save_to_cache(key=hotel_cache_key, value=hotel_results)

# Filter hotels based on budget and star rating

    prior_results=hotel_results,
    budget=80,
    stars=[3]
)

# Sort hotel results by price per night
sorted_hotel_results = sort_results(
    results=filtered_hotel_results,
    column="price_per_night",
    ascending=True
)

# Save the filtered and sorted hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotel_results_las_vegas", value=sorted_hotel_results)

# Search for scenic attractions in Las Vegas
attraction_cache_key = "attractions_las_vegas_scenic"

    attraction_results = search_attractions(
        city="Las Vegas",
        type=["Scenic"]
    )
    save_to_cache(key=attraction_cache_key, value=attraction_results)

# Filter attractions based on type

    prior_results=attraction_results,
    type=["Scenic"]
)

# Save the filtered attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_attraction_results_las_vegas", value=filtered_attraction_results)
